The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] included a '''diplomat''' of a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that had large frills on their necks and a broad tail. This [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomat]] wore a pale blue, loose-fitting garment owned a pet [[Rugger/Legends|rugger]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Viis.jpg|thumb|left|100px|The Viis species as illustrated by Terryl Whitlatch.]]
This character was illustrated by [[Terryl Whitlatch]] for ''[[The Wildlife of Star Wars: A Field Guide]]'', published by [[Chronicle Books]] in [[2001]]. The character resembles the members of the [[Viis Empire]], from the [[W:c:lucasfilm:Alien Chronicles|''Alien Chronicles'']] series written by [[Deborah Chester]] and also illustrated by Whitlatch. The resemblance extends to clothing of the Viis illustrated on the ''Alien Chronicles'' website.<ref name="AE">{{WebCite|url=http://www.lucasaliens.com/israi_bg.html|text=THE VIIS - Israi|archivedate=20050209071132}}</ref>
